text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"—This is my memorable race. 
Ms. Beauty, if you please."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"‘Verxina-chan's choice is the 'Victoria 
Mile'! 
Indeed, that was a truly splendid 
race~~!’"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I take pride in it as the race where I 
demonstrated my full strength best. 
I believe it also proved my prowess as a 
queen..."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"‘Fufu, so it's the race that supports who 
you are today—magnificent! 
Verxina-chan, you pass the 1st 
Checkpoint~!’"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Ehehe, the checkpoint was so fun♪ 
I got to see so~ many of Onee-chan's 
races♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Onee-chan really is amazing~ 
Every single race is so cool♡"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"It's such a shame you could only pick 
one~! 
There are so many other touching races—... 
Onee-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"—Oh dear, I'm sorry. I spaced out for a 
second. 
Let's hurry and move on to the next one!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Yeah! Let's go, Onee-chan!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"We've been through here—all right. 
Fufu, navigating this maze has become 
second nature, hasn't it?♪"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now then, onto the next path—Sky-san?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I was always swayed by my mother's 
"brilliant talent"—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Yet my classmate who won that day 
kept her eyes fixed carefully, directly on 
the 'brilliant talents' around her."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Without being blinded by their 
brilliance, 
she worked out her own way forward with 
her own strength."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
(I thought King picked me as her Muse Maid 
for this audition entirely for her own 
sake...)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
(But looking back on the day she invited 
me—)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Haa—haa—haa... 
...Dammit."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
(This isn't good enough... 
At this rate, I'll never stand a chance 
against Spe-chan and the others. But—)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ............Is this... my limit...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"............ 
Excuse me, Sky-san? I have a small favor 
to ask—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
(...Somehow, it feels like... 
She's making a point of showing me this—)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you spacing out for?! 
If there's nothing here, let's keep 
moving!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Well, I've been on the move since 
morning, so I'm beat~ 
Hey, why don't we take a little breather 
here?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Geez, you know there's a time limit, 
right?! 
Stop complaining and let's go!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay. 
Man, King really works Sei-chan to the 
bone~

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
And the candidates are rushing in one 
after another 
here at the 2nd Checkpoint!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Whether slowed down by the massive maze or 
beaten by the clock, 
over half have already been eliminated! 
But on the other hand!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—I'm here, Beauty!! 
Hurry up and give us the second challenge!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, full marks for energy♪ Now, my rough 
diamonds! 
Here, I want to see the strength of your 
hearts!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Which rough diamond will conquer the 
pressure and clear this checkpoint? 
With that said, here is the next 
challenge!!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Take on 120 Glasses! 
The Exciting 8-Tier Glass Tower Tablecloth 
Pull Challenge!!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaat?! What is that?! It's so high! 
And scary!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
One little touch and that whole thing's 
gonna fall! 
Pulling the cloth without knocking it over 
is totally impossible~~!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Um, what happens if we fail this...?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: “Oh, naturally—”

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: “You're. Dis. Qual. I. Fied♪”

text_block_list.name: Candidates
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaaaaaaat!?!?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, why the shock? Didn't I say this 
was to test 
the strength of our rough diamonds' 
hearts?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
“Sink or swim, you only get one shot! 
Give it a go whenever you're ready, my 
rough diamonds♪”
